Shizuka casually manipulating her way into another person's panties.

JP/CN: https://e-hentai.org/g/3837668/88a036bdd7/
Textless: https://e-hentai.org/g/3886642/55210ddad1/

Criticism or advice welcome!

ずど is apparently a variation of ずっと, at least as suggested by a language model. Google Translate also agrees, when the words in that sentence. I don't usually resort to only machine-made info, but I couldn't find any actual stuff on it. I guess English material on the differences of Japanese dialects is pretty limited. Does Shizuka actually speak with a regional accent, anyway? I didn't pay attention to it during the show, I was too busy crying. I noticed other peculiarities with the dialogue, but I'm not sure if some of them are typos or variations (like こらから, when she later says これから).

Also, I tried decensoring for the first time, since there was only one page that required it. Hopefully it's passable. Working around the screentones is painful.

By the way, does Japanese have a way to express "decensored", in contrast to "uncensored"? I see 無修正 used for both terms here. Does it carry that meaning as well?
